products.description:
A small lantern in 14k gold: an ice-blue glass enamel roof, an open window, and a lab-grown white sapphire standing in for the flame. A winter-evening brooch for Christmas and the months after.

THE PIECE
25.6 mm tall and 15 mm wide. A round hanging ring sits on the triangular roof; two 1.4 mm posts frame an open window 11.2 by 12 mm, with a 1.0 mm gold rod rising to the stone at its centre.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.36 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.39 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold roof edges.

STONES
One 1.8 mm round lab-grown white sapphire in a round tube collet, open at the back. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.
